payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CMIP6 climate models show accuracy in simulating processes relevant to precipitation changes, supported by observed data.

claims.text: The relationship between relative spatial precipitation patterns and the forced precipitation trend derived from climate model simulations suggests accuracy of the CMIP6 climate models.
Detection of forced change in mean and extreme precipitation indicates that the models can simulate these processes effectively.
The observed forced trends are larger than the unforced piControl trend distribution, supporting the models' accuracy in simulating variability.
